instruction.text: Vervollständige den Dialog zwischen May und Lewis.

hint.text:
Verwendung des Gerundiums:
• nach Verben, Adjektiven und Nomen, die zusammen mit Präpositionen auftreten
• nach den Verben to enjoy, to finish, to imagine, to keep, to miss, to practise

Verwendung des Infinitivs:
• nach Adjektiven und Nomen ohne Präpositionen
• nach to ask, to expect, to invite, to need, to want, to wish
hint.sound: Die Verwendung des Gerundiums. Das Gerundium folgt immer nach Verben, Adjektiven und Nomen, die zusammen mit Präpositionen auftreten. Das Gerundium steht außerdem immer nach den Verben <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to enjoy, to finish, to imagine, to keep, to miss, to practise.</voice> Die Verwendung des Infinitivs. Nach Adjektiven und Nomen ohne Präpositionen steht immer der Infinitiv. Außerdem folgt der Infinitiv immer nach <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to ask, to expect, to invite, to need, to want, to wish.</voice>

atoms.b: I am so tired! Ever since my younger sister was born, I haven't been able to sleep at all. She just never stops ((++crying to_cry)).
Oh no, I feel so sorry for you. I still remember ((++spending to_spend)) a lot of time at my best friend's house after my siblings were born.
Oh, really? I am so happy ((++to_talk talking)) to someone who understands me.

wrong.text: Denke daran, dass nach Adjektiven ohne Präpositionen immer der Infinitiv steht.

atoms.b: Trust me, I know how you feel. Did you try ((++singing to_sing)) to her?
My parents tried everything! It just doesn't work. I'm starting to get the feeling she wants ((++to_keep keeping)) us awake.
You know that's not true. It's just her only way ((communicating ++to_communicate)) with you.

wrong.text: Denke daran, dass nach Nomen ohne Präpositionen immer der Infinitiv steht.

atoms.b: It would be totally fine by me if she stopped ((++communicating to_communicate)) for a few hours. I really need ((++to_concentrate concentrating)) and study for the upcoming exam. I am honestly thinking about ((++moving to_move)) in with my best friend!

Oh May, I totally understand that this is hard for you. No one expects you ((++to_adapt adapting)) to this new situation so quickly. It takes time, trust me. I am convinced you are good at ((++comforting to_comfort)) her.
Yes, I know you are right. I don't mean ((++to_behave behaving)) unfairly. After all, she is only a baby. Sometimes the idea of ((++caring to_care)) for a younger sibling just scares me a little.
I know, it’s a totally normal reaction. But aren’t you proud ((++to_have having)) a younger sister?
Of course, I am. Sometimes I just miss ((++being to_be)) an only child.
Trust me, you will get used to ((++being to_be)) a sister, and I'm sure you will enjoy ((++spending to_spend)) some time with her. I just love ((++to_cuddle ++cuddling)) my younger siblings.
And listen: You totally have the right ((++to_be being)) annoyed sometimes. But I am convinced you have the strength ((++to_get getting)) through this!
Thank you, Lewis, you are a really good friend!
